notes.title: AKIMBOT IS OUT NOW! 🚀
notes.content:

notes.title: Shipset’s Log | It’s Weapons Time! 🔫
notes.content:
WEAPONS! 

Hey everybot, Shipset here! They let me do another one of these logs! So as you may be aware... 

IT’S TWO WEEKS UNTIL LAUNCH!!  

That’s coming up quick! You should probably start thinkin’ about how you’re gonna take down Evilware and his MASSIVE army. Which meaaaaaaans you're gonna need some firepower...  

Cue the epic shoot-y weapons montage!

[previewyoutube=qbimk-NPsak;full][/previewyoutube]
 
BLADE
BOLT-TO-BOLT COMBAT

It’s nothing personal... but this weapon is! The Blade is best for when you’re surrounded or have an enemy you can get close to. Get up close with one of Evilware’s goons and- WHAM!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/3f00563524a0ed701a46debefa403a90d7b87e5d.jpg


ASSAULT RIFLE
OLD FAITHFUL

Ahhh, a classic. Perfect, no notes – get me 14 of ‘em right now. This one’s tried and true. Focusing on speed over firepower, this will do great in any typical gunfight against a few enemies at a time – but be careful not to overheat it. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/eabeb271ec5694eee8a87df01d26efbed7b9eb83.jpg
 

ROCKET LAUNCHER 
SHIELD DESTROYER

A FREAKIN’ ROCKET LAUNCHER?!  OHHH this thing is gonna be SUPER handy in destroying those annoying shields! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/ec75a415c5263c9249087fb6cbb56028fb22adf8.jpg


NANO TURBINE
AIM, CLICK, DELETE

One minute they’re there... the next? GONE. Great for picking off targets from a long distance away and dealing BIG damage. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/be1e69852b7bd2f7fffb92e0615188ff326062fb.jpg


ACID THROWER
BOT MELTER

This one’s spicyyyy - turn Evilware’s army into BOT SOUP! Going up against a GIANT HORDE OF EVIL DINOSAUR ROBOTS? This thing has a wide spray, so if your aim is a little off, I’d suggest just giving enemies a good hosing down with this thing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/dcc8aa977c53c6a6c431cabaeb1dcc42decf1d79.jpg


LASER GUN
SUSTAINED DESTRUCTION

No way... LASERS TOO?! Just hold down the trigger and swing this thing around! Dealing a steady stream of damage – provided you can keep a lock on your target –  this one is a good pick. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/b28029dacb2bd7e4c403301c469e2e024d8b2e01.jpg
 

AKIMBOS
DUAL-WIELDING GOODNESS

Hey, look at me! I’m a cowbot! 🤠 If you’re faster on the trigger and in combat, use these bad boys while spinning circles around enemies. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/a2a572ef734f8b35a00c8df70662e1f51371d1b6.jpg


SoooOOoooo much to choose from! Now that you’ve met the crew and checked out your arsenal, I’ll show you around next time.  

See ya August 29!  

Bye-bye for now!
Shipset

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/fadfa1d891d7a8717a5db3e5e2bcca31e0c8e2b3.png
 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/f311c71db5cc3fd9be2bc5f65b827c92349cc263.png

notes.title: Shipset’s Log | Meet the Characters 👋
notes.content:
HEY EVERYBOT! Shipset coming at you with my first LOG! The devs are REALLY busy right now, I don’t know if you noticed but... 

IT’S AKIMBOT LAUNCH MONTH!!!!!  

No big deal, no big deal... but GET EXCITED! 

OH how ruuuude of me! You haven’t been introduced, allow me... 

[previewyoutube=uNpL8pW4u98;full][/previewyoutube]
 
MEET THE CHARACTERS! 

EXE
MERCENARY / HACKER / BUZZKILL

Exe may seem like a total buzzkill... because he is. Heh, he can be a little shy at first, but we’ll bring him out of his shell in no time! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/61a5db8727790952ebeb9cb0d7aafdd2268c8611.jpg


SHIPSET
ADVANCED AI / KNOW-IT-ALL

HEY IT’S MEEEEE! Waaait a minute, KNOW-IT-ALL?! Did you mean a delightful bot with the most extensive internal wiki? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/9e7fd663ebd197e00ef1fc4b135103d4cfb82296.jpg
 

AMBASSADOR 
BOSSY BOOTS

More like AmBOSSYdor, ammiright? The Ambassador is always telling us what to do – something something sAvE tHe uNiVeRsE, Exe! He means well, but wow, does he talk a lot! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/d28afc7a7244be9f5cd033f23e3d26c7b13b7ba3.jpg


EVILWARE
EVIL EVIL EVIL BOT

Yeah, this one’s in the name – he's the bad guy. Probably wasn't hugged enough as a baby bot - would help explain why he's on a warpath to destroying the universe... yikes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/f5eef00d8bddb95fc834032a82821b44a4b4444a.jpg


And that’s the crew! There’s a lot more we’ll find out along the way, so see you on August 29! Looking forward to saving the universe with you! 
 

Signing off,  
Shipset

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/fadfa1d891d7a8717a5db3e5e2bcca31e0c8e2b3.png

notes.title: Demo Update #1
notes.content:

Thanks everyone for your feedback! In this update we've made the following improvements and changes:

Patch Notes: Demo Update #1

 Changed 'Smash Attack' to trigger on second consecutive melee attack
 Moved the shop to after the assault rifle to improve level flow
 Added DLSS profile settings
 Added HDR setting
 Improved GPU performance
 Several minor fixes

notes.title: Akimbot | Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Akimbot 🤝 Steam Next Fest
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012559/08bea948adfccec0ccf9148950893ee5902f4519.jpg

Play the Akimbot Demo now!
It's time to hack, dash, and slash your way through the universe...

Akimbot has a demo featuring in Steam Next Fest! 🎉

We're so excited for you to begin your adventure with Exe and Shipset. You can play from RIGHT NOW until 18 June, 10am Pacific Time.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1843540/Akimbot

Meet the dynamic duo, Shipset and Exe, tasked with saving the universe from impending doom! Piece of cake, right?

The demo starts the way all good adventures do - with a prison break. Stranded in Data Bay, the first planet you explore in Akimbot's robot-filled universe, you'll have to jump, dash, and hack your way out of this paradise! Say hi (or bye...) to the locals, try to resist the inviting beaches, or pull up at one of the dance parties (yes, plural).

Blast your way through armies of robots, control spaceships, and forge your own path on a mission to save the universe!

We'd love to see your favourite moments from the Akimbot Demo - please tag us @Akimbot_Game or #Akimbot it up!

Release Date Trailer
In case you missed it! Check out our latest trailer revealing our release date!

Let us know what you think of the demo! If you have any feedback or encounter any bugs and want to help us improve the game even further, come chat with us in our Discord.

Hope to see you there!

notes.title: Welcome to Akimbot! 🤖
notes.content:
Welcome to Akimbot! 🤖
Are you ready for robot mayhem and explosive action?
Well, hold on to your circuits because this 3D action-adventure platformer is PACKED FULL OF THEM!

🔫 Hone your combat style with a huge arsenal of weapons
🪐 Explore a vibrant, unpredictable universe
💥 Hack through ALL kinds of robot enemies

Play as Exe – an outlaw robot venturing through galaxies alongside an unexpected sidekick – Shipset. 

Blast your way through armies of robots, control spaceships, and forge your own path on a mission to save the universe from impending doom! 

Set in a sci-fi world where only robots exist, travel the galaxy and experience non-stop robot mayhem and explosive action!

Your journey begins the way many great stories do – with a prison break.
